input.reasoning: The final page is still the "Update your address" form for "My address" (id_address=7), and its Phone field shows 305-555-0199. That proves the value was typed into the form, not that it was saved. When a PrestaShop address update succeeds, the store normally redirects to the Addresses list and shows an "Address successfully updated" message. Neither appears here. Nothing else on the page shows the change was saved either, such as the address list with the new number. The agent may have filled the field without clicking Save, or the save may not have gone through. It is also possible that it saved and then reopened the form to check, but nothing on the page supports that. The agent's report gives no details, so the change can't be confirmed as saved.
